body:
_Migrated from issue #834, filed 2026-07-11._

The new Account page exposes email and subject settings but omits the email body template field.

Credit: @iroQuai in #628.

Promise (2026-07-02): the missing email field was accepted as real work “on the list.”

Source: https://github.com/new-usemame/Calibre-Web-NextGen/issues/628

resolution.note: Verified in code, not from the changelog: Account.tsx carries mail_body_text at :64, :89 and :178. Migrated from #834 as open on 2026-08-05; the fix predated the migration.

title: Account page: email body template field missing
